Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_PBIen;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/91494e41-5f1c-4983-89ab-08d0b85ea97e/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/802d82ed-d9c5-4e9b-b886-85accc051a08/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_PBIen
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
where dc.customerid in (select distinct customerid from dw.dimcustomeraccount
                    where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP'
                    and banksk = 1)
